gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: The car broke ___ on the motorway.
She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: They're ___ up a new office in the old warehouse district.
A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: When the alarm sounded, everyone made ___ the nearest exit.
gaps.explanation: 'Make for' = move towards, usually in haste.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ off until Thursday.
gaps.explanation: 'Put off' = postpone to a later time.
